turns.speaker: elder_anyi
turns.text: Mola'a ma'a, my child! You greeted me well. Do you know how we greet someone in the evening?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: I don't know that one yet.

turns.speaker: elder_anyi
turns.text: We say 'Ndap sesu'. Try it with me — Ndap sesu.

turns.speaker: elder_anyi
turns.text: Nku'u mbe! Almost. "Aka'a nyu" is used for "Goodbye". For later, we say "Aka'a mbe nnu". Repeat it aloud twice — the tone falls on nnu.
